Batch crawl where one seed URL returns 404 error

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.crawlberg.*;
import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var MAPPER = new ObjectMapper();
        var engineConfig = MAPPER.readValue("{\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}", CrawlConfig.class);
        var engine = io.xberg.crawlberg.Crawlberg.createEngine(engineConfig);
        java.util.List<String> urls = java.util.List.of("https://example.com/good_seed", "https://example.com/bad_seed");
        var result = Crawlberg.batchCrawl(engine, urls);
        System.out.println(result.completedCount());
        System.out.println(result.failedCount());
        System.out.println(result.totalCount());
    }
}
```
